chunks: Said (the Pharaoh): "You have come to believe in him before I gave you leave. He is surely your chief, who taught you magic. You will soon come to know: I will have your hands and feet cut off on alternate sides, and have every one of you crucified."
ai.seo_question: What punishment did Pharaoh threaten to inflict on the believers of Musa?
ai.summary: In this passage from Surah Ash-Shu'ara, Pharaoh (Qarun) addresses his people after they accepted Musa (Moses), accusing him of being their chief magician who taught them sorcery. He threatens them with severe punishment—cutting off hands and feet on alternate sides and crucifying them—to deter them from following him. This reflects the historical context of Pharaoh's rule and his use of fear to maintain control over his people.
